description: This file implements a KeyValueParser class with methods for parsing key-value pairs, multiline data, and events from strings, along with utility functions for debugging and reading parameters. It references external utilities and network utils, and defines parsing logic specific to event strings and key-value data.

classes.name: KeyValueParser
classes.description: A class providing static methods for parsing key-value data, multiline data, and event strings, with debugging and parameter reading utilities.

methods.name: find_first_of_delimiter_pair
methods.description: Finds the first occurrence of a pair of delimiters in a string, returning the position of the start delimiter.

methods.name: parse_line
methods.description: Parses a line from an input stream into key-value pairs based on delimiters.

methods.name: parse_multiline
methods.description: Parses multiple lines from an input stream into a list of key-value maps.

methods.name: parse_event
methods.description: Parses an event string into key-value pairs, handling keyless parameters and delimiters.

methods.name: event_buffer_start_process_idx
methods.description: Finds the start index of event data after log level prefix.

methods.name: parse_event_keyless_params
methods.description: Parses keyless parameters from an event string into a map.

methods.name: read_param
methods.description: Reads a parameter value as integer or string from a parsed line.

methods.name: parsed_obj_debug
methods.description: Logs the contents of a parsed key-value object or list of objects for debugging.
